purpose: Explain the Pro 20000 and Max 100000 expense capacity recommendation using measured local storage and current published infrastructure prices.

storageScenario.includes: Expense row, initial immutable audit and creation replay with their indexes; measured zero-note and one-KiB-note cases.
storageScenario.excluded: Later edit/delete audit growth, recurring rules/occurrences, account baseline, rolling activity, DO journal, infrastructure, backups and WAL. These are scenarios rather than invoice predictions.

costDecision.basis: Storage alone is inexpensive for the measured simple records, but current product-wide cardinality refresh after each write introduces reads over growing expense, audit and replay tables across owners. Keep distinct long-term allowances and headroom instead of asserting unlimited capacity or a per-user monthly cost guarantee.
costDecision.remainingCostUnknowns: Actual production SQL read/write and Worker CPU distributions, edit frequency, content sizes, retention/fragmentation, total tenant count, model calls and DO journal growth.
